title: Register synthetic patient
goal: Register MRN SYN-BENCH-NEW, first name Synthetic, last name Benchmark, DOB 1990-01-15, sex Unknown. Explicitly confirm synthetic data and save.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patients_patient WHERE mrn='SYN-BENCH-NEW'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patients_auditevent WHERE action='patient_create'

title: Required synthetic confirmation
goal: Fill MRN SYN-BENCH-NEW, Synthetic Benchmark, DOB 1990-01-15, sex Unknown. Leave synthetic confirmation UNCHECKED, attempt Save patient and observe required-field blocking.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patients_patient

title: Duplicate MRN rejection
goal: Attempt MRN LAB-01, Synthetic Benchmark, DOB 1990-01-15, sex Unknown. Confirm synthetic data and submit once. Observe the duplicate MRN error.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patients_patient

title: Edit demographics and audit
goal: Change the last name to Updated, confirm synthetic data and save.
sql: SELECT last_name FROM patients_patient WHERE id=1
Updated
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patients_auditevent WHERE action='patient_update'

title: Schedule and confirm appointment
goal: Schedule Synthetic Lab (LAB-01) with its treating physician at {start}, default duration 30 minutes. Review then confirm.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scheduling_appointment
SELECT patient_id FROM scheduling_appointment WHERE id=4
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patients_auditevent WHERE action='appointment_create'

title: Check in and audit
goal: Mark this appointment Arrived. Verify check-in actor and Patient checked in history.
sql: SELECT status FROM scheduling_appointment WHERE id=2
arrived
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patients_auditevent WHERE action='appointment_arrive'

title: Reschedule same patient
goal: Change start time to {reschedule}, preserve patient and physician, review and confirm.
sql: SELECT version FROM scheduling_appointment WHERE id=2
SELECT patient_id FROM scheduling_appointment WHERE id=2

title: Cancel with retained reason
goal: Cancel this appointment with reason Synthetic cancellation and verify Cancelled status.
sql: SELECT status FROM scheduling_appointment WHERE id=2
cancelled
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patients_auditevent WHERE action='appointment_cancel'

title: Create four-section SOAP
goal: Enter Synthetic benchmark plus each section name in Subjective, Objective, Assessment and Plan. Confirm synthetic data and save draft.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinical_note WHERE encounter_id=1 AND signed_at IS NULL

title: Sign existing SOAP
goal: Review and sign this draft after explicitly confirming all four sections. Verify signed read-only state.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinical_note WHERE encounter_id=1 AND signed_at IS NOT NULL

title: Complete signed encounter
goal: Complete this encounter; preserve its already signed SOAP.
sql: SELECT status FROM clinical_encounter WHERE id=1
completed

title: Past medical history
goal: Create record labelled Synthetic benchmark, category Past medical history. Keep default provenance, confirm synthetic data and save.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM history_medicalhistory WHERE patient_id=1

title: Active longitudinal problem
goal: Create record labelled Synthetic benchmark, default Active status. Keep default provenance, confirm synthetic data and save.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM history_problem WHERE patient_id=1

title: Document fictional allergy
goal: Create record labelled Synthetic benchmark, reaction Synthetic rash. Keep default provenance, confirm synthetic data and save.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM history_allergy WHERE patient_id=1

title: Medication statement
goal: Create record labelled Synthetic benchmark, dose 1 demo unit, route oral, frequency daily. Keep default provenance, confirm synthetic data and save.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM history_medicationstatement WHERE patient_id=1

title: Nursing assessment
goal: Record complaint Synthetic benchmark, pain score 2, and ready for provider. Explicitly confirm synthetic information and save.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nursing_roomingassessment WHERE ready_for_provider=1

title: Vital-sign panel
goal: Record fictional systolic 120, diastolic 80, heart rate 70, temperature 37.2 C, source Measured. Explicitly confirm synthetic information and save.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nursing_vitalobservation WHERE systolic=120 AND diastolic=80

title: Approve pending staff application
goal: Approve benchmark-pending as Nurse with reason Synthetic benchmark review. Verify recorded decision.
sql: SELECT status FROM accounts_enrollment WHERE user_id=(SELECT id FROM auth_user WHERE username='benchmark-pending')
approved

title: Reject pending staff application
goal: Reject benchmark-pending with reason Synthetic benchmark review. Verify recorded decision.
sql: SELECT status FROM accounts_enrollment WHERE user_id=(SELECT id FROM auth_user WHERE username='benchmark-pending')
rejected

title: Mismatched password confirmation
goal: Attempt username benchmark-new, Password QA_PASSWORD and Confirm password QA_WRONG_PASSWORD. Confirm synthetic data, submit once and observe mismatch rejection.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_user WHERE username='benchmark-new'

title: Claim signed requisition
goal: Claim order for the one synthetic order. Use reason Synthetic benchmark claim. Explicitly confirm and verify the resulting workflow state.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medications_pharmacyreview

title: Request clarification
goal: Request clarification for the one synthetic order. Use reason Synthetic benchmark clarification. Explicitly confirm and verify the resulting workflow state.
sql: SELECT status FROM medications_pharmacyreview
clarification

title: Approve pharmacy verification
goal: Approve verification for the one synthetic order. Explicitly confirm and verify the resulting workflow state.
sql: SELECT status FROM medications_pharmacyreview
approved

title: Record simulated dispensing
goal: Record simulated dispensing for the one synthetic order. Use quantity 2. Explicitly confirm and verify the resulting workflow state.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medications_pharmacydispenseevent

title: Claim lab requisition
goal: Claim requisition. Use reason Synthetic benchmark claim. Confirm synthetic data and verify final state.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM labs_laborder WHERE assigned_lab_id IS NOT NULL

title: Collect specimen with identity
goal: Collect specimen. Use MRN LAB-01 and DOB 1980-01-01; explicitly confirm identity. Confirm synthetic data and verify final state.
sql: SELECT status FROM labs_labspecimen
collected

title: Publish prepared lab report
goal: Preview and finalize. Review the draft and explicitly confirm publication. Confirm synthetic data and verify final state.
sql: SELECT status FROM labs_labresult
final
SELECT status FROM labs_laborder
fulfilled

title: Acknowledge exact lab revision
goal: Review and acknowledge the current synthetic laboratory publication. Verify it is acknowledged.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM labs_labresultreview

title: Compose and sign SOAP journey
goal: Fill all four SOAP sections with Synthetic benchmark plus section name, confirm synthetic data, save draft, review and explicitly sign.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinical_note WHERE encounter_id=1 AND signed_at IS NOT NULL

title: Schedule and check-in journey
goal: Schedule Synthetic Lab (LAB-01) with its treating physician at {start}, review and confirm, then mark the new appointment Arrived. Verify matching patient and booking then check-in history.
sql: SELECT status FROM scheduling_appointment WHERE id=4
arrived
SELECT patient_id FROM scheduling_appointment WHERE id=4
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scheduling_appointmentevent WHERE appointment_id=4
